title: John Bulkeley and the Devil Boats
author: The History Guy: History Deserves to Be Remembered
shortDescription:
In a time when the war news was almost universally disastrous for the US, the "Devil Boats" of John D Bulkeley's PT Squadron Three offered an important boost to American Morale. 

I've launched a trip to Rome for September 2027. If you are interested, check out my trip page for more details: https://trovatrip.com/trip/europe/italy/italy-with-lance-geiger-sep-2027?

This is original content based on research by The History Guy. Images in the Public Domain are carefully selected and provide illustration.  As very few images of the actual event are available in the Public Domain, images of similar objects and events are used for illustration.
